name: 46637 · South Bend, IN
findings: ZIP 46637 (South Bend) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46637 (South Bend) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46637 (South Bend) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46637 (South Bend) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
